name: QWEN-HEAD-RESTORE-0
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG QWEN-HEAD-RESTORE-0; the prose governs on any conflict. Registered before any vendor weight byte was retrieved and before any stage of scratch/qwen_head_restore.py produced a real receipt. E0 (4,722 positions) is the diagnostic set; the corpus (356) and prefix (98) records are the validation set; nothing is fitted, calibrated or selected on any outcome. Bar 2 (slope) is reported separately and never counts as success on its own; bar 4 (KL) is a calibration reading, not a recovery of teacher decisions. The bootstrap clause of VALIDATED is a hand rule stated here before any score exists; the adjudicator scores the four bars and the refutation ratio only. Smoke exercised every stage including runtime (stand-in head, labelled) before this registration.

S16.description: arm C's compressed S16 lm_head (block-128 e8m0 scales, 16 fp16 levels) decoded to float32 by the kernels' decode path, applied in float32 to arm C's final-norm hidden states (the frozen E0 dump of logs/qmetal/prefill_serve/census_d42cb215.json and the corpus/prefix states of the corpus stage)

BF16.description: the vendor's original lm_head.weight (Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B revision 1d4bf0f2, shard model-00018-of-00018, BF16 [248320, 5120]) widened exactly to float32, applied in float32 to the same hidden rows

BF16_H16.description: control: the vendor head with the hidden rows rounded to bfloat16 before the float32 product (evaluation-precision sensitivity)

S16_PROD.description: control: the production fp16 Metal logits of the same E0 positions (the census dump), the path the serving runtime takes

bars.name: E0-AGREEMENT-DIAGNOSTIC
bars.description: paired teacher top-1 agreement of BF16 minus S16 over the 4,722 E0 positions, in percentage points (corrected minus newly broken, over 4,722): at least +1.0 point, i.e. a net of at least 48 positions. Diagnostic only: E0 is the set the disagreement was characterised on and is never reported as independent evidence of recovery.

bars.name: E0-SLOPE
bars.description: median over E0 positions of the centered least-squares slope of candidate logits on teacher logits over the teacher's top-16 (the census statistic), BF16 median minus S16 median: at least +0.03 (toward 1). Reported separately; never a success metric alone.

bars.name: VALIDATION-AGREEMENT
bars.description: paired teacher top-1 agreement of BF16 minus S16 pooled over the 454 corpus and prefix positions, in points: at least +1.0 (a net of at least 5 positions), with neither the corpus nor the prefix net negative. This is the decisive bar: a head that improves E0 but not this set is not a validated recovery.

bars.name: VALIDATION-KL
bars.description: mean forward KL(teacher || candidate) over the 454 validation positions, BF16 over S16 minus one: at most -0.10 (a ten percent reduction). A calibration reading: it can fire while greedy agreement is unchanged, and then it is not a recovery of teacher decisions.

operands.name: E0 final-norm hidden states and production fp16 logits (4,722 rows)
E0 rows (teacher token, margins, draft argmax, family, step)
teacher records (rollout, corpus, prefix logits and token lists)
arm C CPU top-1 agreement on the corpus and prefixes (reconstruction cross-check)

refuted_if: bar 1 NO-FIRE and bar 3 NO-FIRE: max_bar13_ratio = max(delta_agree_points_e0 / 1.0, v / 1.0) below 1.0, where v is delta_agree_points_validation when both conjunct nets (corpus, prefix) are at least 0 and min(delta_agree_points_validation, 0) otherwise, so a bar 3 that fails on a conjunct counts as NO-FIRE in the ratio. Refuted means: the head-only hypothesis, that a substantial part of arm C's teacher disagreement is lm_head quantisation error, is refuted at the registered resolution; head-only restoration is not worthwhile and attention moves to compressed-body error. Verdict classes: VALIDATED iff bars 1 and 3 FIRE and the 95 percent block-bootstrap interval of the bar 3 delta excludes zero (a FIRE whose interval includes zero is reported as FIRE-AT-LOW-RESOLUTION and does not make VALIDATED); E0-ONLY (bar 1 FIRE, bar 3 NO-FIRE) is not a validated recovery; CALIBRATION-ONLY (bar 4 FIRE, bars 1 and 3 NO-FIRE) is a calibration result; NULL otherwise. The runtime stage (resident bf16 head cost) runs only on VALIDATED.
registered_prior: The compile-time decode fixture (logs/qwenmodel1/score_C.json) puts the S16 head at relative L2 error 0.108 against the vendor head, so the head is not a precise copy; still the registered reading of the E0 census is that the top-16 flattening (slope 0.88, top-1 under-reproduced by 2.9 nats) is mostly body-side, because the same flattening appears at every teacher margin and the head is a linear map applied to an already-shifted state. Prior: bar 1 between 0 and +2 points, probability of FIRE 0.4; bar 2 delta under 0.03 in magnitude, probability 0.25; bar 3 within -1 and +1.5 points, probability of FIRE 0.3; bar 4 probability 0.4. The opener: the head swap flips 'The' to 'We' on fewer than half of the 24 prompts. Controls: BF16_H16 within 0.2 points of BF16 on every set; S16_PROD within 0.1 points of S16 on E0 (fp16 near-ties only).
